thread:
sam-sales: Hey team, Coastline POC is hitting intermittent 429s while doing an embeddings livestream ingest. Started ~11:10 UTC, spikes ~every 6min for ~30s. Demo in 45m. Can we triage?

izzy-eng: Can you paste a sample 429 body and any x-ratelimit headers from their client? Also batch size + concurrency?

sam-sales: Client 429: {
  "error": "rate_limited",
  "retry_after": 0.35,
  "trace_id": "cl-2c5d"
}
They use `batch_size=150`, `workers=20`.

hugo-sre: Server log snippet: `429 tenant=coastline route=/v1/embeddings limit=100 remaining=0 reset=28 token_budget_remaining=52000`
Headers: `X-RateLimit-Limit: 100`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0`, `X-RateLimit-Reset: 28`

tara-support: Tenant config: per_route_rps=100, token_budget_per_min=250000, burst_window=60s. At ~40 tokens/item, 150 items ~=6k tokens/request. With many workers that's heavy.

izzy-eng: Two things: large batches + high concurrency. Also client retries with fixed 300ms backoff (no jitter) per their SDK. That can amplify on reset.

sam-sales: Coastline asks if we can lift limits for the demo. They need steady throughput for 30-60 minutes.

hugo-sre: We can do a short soft bump. Suggest per_route_rps=300 and token_budget=1M/min for 60 minutes. I'll need SRE approval. Also advise the client to reduce workers->8 and batch->64.

ops-bot: Ticket created: INC-5309. Requested: per_route_rps=300, token_budget_per_min=1000000, duration=60m. Requested by hugo-sre. Pending approval.

tara-support: Pushed quick-runbook note to Coastline: "Set workers<=8, batch<=64, enable exponential backoff + jitter, honor Retry-After header." Sent sample code for jittered backoff.

izzy-eng: Also ask for a `trace_id` from any subsequent 429s so we can correlate traces.

hugo-sre: Approved. Soft bump applied for tenant=coastline for 1h. Monitor at console.redwood.io/tenants/coastline/limits.

sam-sales: I told Coastline to reduce concurrency and that we'll apply a temporary bump. They lowered workers to 8 and kept batch=150 for demo.

izzy-eng: Monitoring logs. If 429s persist include `trace_id`. Watching token burn now.

sam-sales: Update 12m: 429s dropped to near-zero after bump + reduced workers. Demo continuing fine.

tara-support: Added note to POC summary: "For sustained streaming ingests, contact sales for Dedicated capacity or sustained token budget. Short-lived bumps available for demos only."

hugo-sre: Soft bump expired after 1h and reverted to standard limits. No further 429s reported. If they plan production, recommend dedicated quota.

sam-sales: Thanks all :thumbsup:. Closing thread, will follow up on Dedicated discussion separately.
